note: R106 is the untagged candidate that repairs the customer-workspace list contract after R105 returned HTTP 400 for the real filter/sort/limit query and production was jointly rolled back to the exact R101 runtime baseline. R102, R103 and R104 remain immutable undeployed audit evidence, and R105 remains immutable deployment-and-rollback evidence. R106 preserves companyId/RBAC isolation, explicit DTO whitelisting, bounded search and pagination, evidence-first CustomerFactProposal review, DRAFT_ONLY and human approval boundaries, and forbids automatic real outbound delivery.

source.parentBaselineCommitNote: The production R101 annotated tag is the direct parent and rollback anchor for the standalone Linux release commit.
source.contentCommitNote: R101 is the immutable rollback ancestry anchor. The authoritative R106 content commit is resolved from source.releaseTag only after the project-root standalone release tree passes every pre-tag gate and is committed and tagged; R102 through R105 remain immutable audit evidence and are not rewritten.
source.releaseTagNote: The target immutable Linux and local release tag is vaysen-crm-lan-pilot-v1.4.87-r106; it does not exist until all pre-tag gates pass, and once created it must never be moved and must peel to the health, OCI revision and deployment commit.
source.buildRevisionNote: Resolve the immutable build revision with git rev-parse vaysen-crm-lan-pilot-v1.4.87-r106^{} before every image build and acceptance run.

runtime.decision: All R106 local release gates and Windows packaging must run through F:\toolchains\node-v20.18.0-win-x64. Linux image builds use the reviewed Node 20.18.0 digest pin.
pinnedFiles: root, backend, frontend and Electron package.json engines.node = >=20 <21
root, backend, frontend and Electron package.json engines.npm = >=10 <11

frontend.buildCommand: npm --prefix frontend run build; npm --prefix electron run build:frontend
frontend.note: The complete Vitest, typecheck, Web production build and Electron export are mandatory pre-tag gates for R106, including the shared customer-workspace query fixture.
frontend.testRunner: R106 full Vitest suite and production build gate
frontend.reproducibilityNote: The candidate is tagged only after the controlled Node/npm full frontend test, typecheck, Web build and Electron export gates pass.
frontend.healthcheckNote: Production acceptance must prove /login and the authenticated customer workspace return 200, and the real customer list query no longer returns 400 on R106.

backend.buildMode: NestJS production application and backend-worker builds
backend.note: The complete Jest suite, typecheck, production runtime-load build, Prisma/security contracts, isolated PostgreSQL 15 gate and customer-assets real-PG contract are mandatory pre-tag gates.
backend.testRunner: R106 full backend Jest plus customer-workspace HTTP contract and isolated PostgreSQL 15 contracts
backend.reproducibilityNote: The candidate is tagged only after all controlled local backend and database gates pass.
backend.healthcheckNote: Production acceptance requires status=ok, tag/commit/buildCommit equality and matchesBuild=true.

electron.apiBase: /api through the packaged Electron local same-origin proxy
electron.note: Electron 1.4.34 is built only after R106 Linux acceptance. The installer hash and isolated lifecycle smoke evidence are recorded in the execution handoff, not guessed before the immutable release tag exists.
electron.testRunner: Full Electron Jest, typecheck, update-chain and frontend export are pre-tag gates; isolated real installer smoke follows Linux acceptance
electron.reproducibilityNote: The version and lockfile are frozen in the R106 candidate; the unsigned LAN installer is generated from the exact tag only after production acceptance.

database.note: R106 contains exactly 37 sorted migrations. Production R101 already reports 37 successful migrations after the R105 rollback, so R106 production prisma migrate deploy must be an explicit no-op; any unexpected migration, drift or failure stops cutover.
database.preflight: Run all 37 migrations twice against isolated PostgreSQL 15 databases and execute the customer-assets real-PG contract without using production data.
database.backup: Before R106 cutover, create and SHA-256 verify a consistent PostgreSQL backup from the running R101 production database.
database.restoreDrill: Rehearse the candidate against a disposable restored R101 backup before stopping production writers.

dockerImages.policy: Build and switch only backend, frontend and backend-worker from the immutable R106 tag in a new release directory. Before any backup or mutation, validate every one of the 16 running R101 services against security/release-runtime-baselines/vaysen-crm-lan-pilot-v1.4.82-r101.json: exact Config.Image, inspect image ID, per-service OCI revision, Compose project/service labels and health constraints. Missing images, ID drift, service gaps, duplicates or rendered-Compose drift fail closed. Keep the legitimate R101 python-service revision 6052466b4da62ccb3abab615bb5d23a9d0857bcc and do not rebuild or switch PostgreSQL, Redis, n8n, SearXNG or other unrelated infrastructure. Prepare and switch only the required reviewed OpenClaw runtime and edge proxy.
dockerImages.baseImage: node:20.18.0-slim and unchanged reviewed production image digest pins

gate.command: Controlled Node 20.18.0/npm 10.8.2: full backend Jest; full frontend Vitest; full Electron Jest; all typechecks; backend/frontend production builds; Electron export; Prisma/security/deploy contracts; isolated PostgreSQL 15 migrations and customer-assets real-PG; production audits; git diff --check.
gate.script: R106 release acceptance record plus package scripts, scripts/verify-runtime-image-baseline.mjs and scripts/test-deploy-contracts.sh
covers: Complete tracked/untracked ownership inventory with no browser-extension or temporary test artifacts
High-confidence secret/token/API-key/private-key scan and customer-body/private-credential review
CompanyId/RBAC, human approval, CustomerFactProposal evidence review, DRAFT_ONLY and no-auto-send boundaries
Fixed welcome or near-template global quality gate with one compact retry and explicit downgrade error
Structured Ask/Insight/Draft/Action diagnostics and at least 24 prompt regressions
Exact 37-migration source tree and isolated PostgreSQL 15 compatibility
Shared frontend/backend customer-workspace HTTP query fixture, strict DTO rejection and non-empty service response
R101 rollback ancestry, project-root standalone tree, exact 16-service runtime baseline and target immutable R106 release tag
gate.note: R106 / vaysen-crm-lan-pilot-v1.4.87-r106 is created only after every local gate and the exported-tree contracts pass. R102 through R105 remain immutable audit evidence, and no commit, tag, package, installation or deployment is created by this defect-fix task. Deployment must preserve DRAFT_ONLY and human approval, must not confirm Action or send real messages, and must roll back to the exact R101 runtime baseline on any cutover or acceptance failure.
